page.content:
2012–14 sibling series set seventy years later.

How The Legend of Korra connects

  • Character: Korra — The Legend of Korra is Korra's story as the next Avatar.
  • Creator: Michael Dante DiMartino — DiMartino co-created The Legend of Korra.
  • Creator: Bryan Konietzko — Konietzko co-created The Legend of Korra.
  • Topic: Avatar: The Last Airbender — Korra is a sibling series in the same Avatar world.
  • Series: Avatar: The Last Airbender (series) — The Legend of Korra follows seventy years after Aang's war.

What is The Legend of Korra?

The Legend of Korra follows the next Avatar, Korra of the Southern Water Tribe, through Republic City, new bending forms, and later spiritual crises.

Key threads lead to Korra, Michael Dante DiMartino, Bryan Konietzko, Avatar: The Last Airbender and Avatar: The Last Airbender (series).
